plan: With 3 bidders and uniform values on [0,49], the optimal first-price auction bid shading factor is (n-1)/n = 2/3 of my value, assuming symmetric equilibrium bidding. My value is $19, so I should bid approximately 19 * (2/3) ≈ $12.7. This balances winning probability against profit margin, avoiding overpaying while still competing effectively against Betty and Charles who likely follow similar strategies.

With 3 bidders and values uniform on $0-$49, the Nash equilibrium bidding strategy in a first-price auction is to bid (n-1)/n times your value, which here is 2/3. This balances winning probability against profit margin. My value is $44, so I'll bid approximately $29.30 to shade appropriately below my value while remaining competitive against the other two bidders' likely bids.
